items.title: How Far Could ISRG Stock Bounce From Here?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) stock could climb 23.9% to the April high it last fell back from, and you would risk about 5% to find out. That looks like a surgical-robot leader on sale, but the price history disagrees. Over the last two years, none of its visits to this price range turned into a 20% gain before a 5% drop.

items.title: What Would It Take For Pfizer To Cut Its Dividend?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) has returned 23.1% over the past year and trades about 5% below its three-year high. Yet one question keeps coming back on its earnings calls: would it ever cut the dividend? An analyst asked it outright on the August call, and another tied it to a big acquisition in May. So what would a cut take, and what would it change.
